name: occamy-1.0
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 30 of 40 layers are linear_attention and 10 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 35.107 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-13. RECORDED 2026-10-25 from the card's own HTML benchmark table, where its column is first and the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B starting checkpoint is the second column of the same table. Wins on 10 of the rows transcribed: Terminal-Bench 2.1 59.00 vs 49.50, Claw-Eval average 82.20 vs 69.50, Claw-Eval Pass^3 71.40 vs 54.80, WildClawBench 49.16 vs 40.40, CommerceAgentBench 37.38 vs 19.60, OfficeQA Pro 48.10 vs 39.10, tau^3-Banking 37.10 vs 11.90, AutomationBench Pass^1 27.60 vs 7.50, BFCL v4 65.40 vs 63.19, IFEval 91.53 vs 86.90. LOSES on VitaBench (41.75 vs 34.25 is a win, but 46.00 for BigBang beats it) and sits below larger models on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (Ornith-1.5 67.80, GPT-5.6 Sol 88.80). No harness is printed for either the card column or the base column, and the card asterisks only the third-party official numbers, so these base-vs-tuned rows are nominally like-for-like but unverifiable. Not a low-VRAM target: 35B total / 3B active with a vision tower kept in the checkpoint; bf16 weights are 70.22 GB per the card's file table, so it needs expert offload. The card also ships 17 GGUF variants and MLX 3-8 bit cuts, all still marked 'Mac Metal acceptance pending'. IMAGE EVALS 2026-11-02: the card's results SVG carries a Business Arena panel that was absent from this record while every other Occamy-1.0 cell in the same table was present. Added $79,868 (base $44,751, column max $168,867). This panel, unlike VitaBench, IS in the figure, so the row is figure-sourced and was cross-checked against the card's HTML table.

benchmarks.name: GDPval (Elo)
benchmarks.config: Read off the card's figure (read by eye, caveat +-0.5). Second independent vision read of this panel returned the same number. Card figure is an SVG (text layer read directly, then values confirmed against the card's own HTML table, which prints 1,128). Base Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is 1,004. Elo, scale 1000 as used elsewhere in this dataset for GDPval-AA Elo. SVG-layer cross-check 2026-11-06: the figure was rasterized from its SVG source (cairosvg 2x) and re-read by vision_analyze, and its text nodes were read programmatically; both agree with this value.

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench (partial credit)
benchmarks.config: Card HTML BENCHMARK RESULTS table, row 'AutomationBench (partial)', Occamy-1.0 column: 69.10 (base column Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 39.40). Harness not printed. PROVENANCE CORRECTED 2026-11-06: this row previously claimed it had been read off the card's results figure and confirmed by a second vision read of that panel. That is false. The card's assets/occamy-main-results.svg contains exactly ONE AutomationBench panel, and it plots the Pass^1 variant only (Occamy 27.60, base 7.50); the string '69.1' does not occur anywhere in the SVG text layer (verified programmatically, not by eye). The value is correct but it is table-only: the partial-credit variant is never charted. Caveat: it is the same task family as AutomationBench (Pass^1) 27.60, so the two must not be averaged together.

benchmarks.name: Business Arena (USD)
benchmarks.config: Card results FIGURE (assets/occamy-main-results.svg), 'Business Arena' panel, Occamy-1.0 (green, first bar): printed $79,868. The value inside the bar, $44,751, is the base column Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a second Occamy number. Confirmed three ways: the SVG text layer read directly (no eye-reading, so the +/-0.5 caveat does not apply), a zoomed vision read of the panel, and the card's own HTML results table, which prints $79,868 in the Occamy-1.0 column. Score stored as DOLLARS, not a share: scale is the column maximum (GPT-5.6 Sol $168,867), so read the row with scale only - same convention as models/ammonixrcm-writer-9b 'Money on rejected claims (USD)'. Metric is revenue generated against the Business Arena task set, higher better; the card prints no harness or episode count.
